The '''Pallis Oversector''', also known as '''Sector 16''', was the theaters of operations of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Sixteenth Army|16th Sector Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was reorganized in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oversector/Legends|Priority Sector]] and placed under the rule of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Coy]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="EGTW5">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22128732052/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-5|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 5}}</ref><ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
